representative_scale.selection: All PINDER-S 2024-02 cases with both primary apo monomers, sorted by stable PINDER ID; no adaptive subsampling.
representative_scale.candidate_count_basis: Intake design choice, not claimed as published baseline setting; fixed before execution.
representative_scale.separate_aav_challenge: Three specified entries, redocking from separated components only; assembly/chain extraction must be established before challenge execution.

inputs.source: data.json pins_and_hashes and brief.md exact inventory
inputs.primary: Paired apo receptor/ligand and corresponding native holo dimer plus mappings for fixed 93 cases
inputs.generated: Preprocessed docking inputs and potential grids; preserve residue mapping and chain assignments
inputs.software: Pinned PINDER source plus owner-approved unverified FroDock mirror and exact bin/soap.bin

outputs.scoring: pinder_eval per-model *_metrics.csv and *_leaderboard.csv; DockQ, iRMSD, LRMSD, fnat; explicit missing-case records
outputs.reports: Per-case top-1 and best-of-100 DockQ; fraction acceptable over fixed 93-case denominator; time, throughput, cost, failures, hardware and provenance

timing_scope.primary: End-to-end per-case wall time from preprocessed coordinates through grid generation, docking, clustering and writing ranked poses; sum over fixed workload.
timing_scope.time_to_acceptable: Requires chronological candidate completion timestamps plus retrospective DockQ evaluation. If only final ranked batch available, record unavailable; do not treat rank as generation time.
timing_scope.repeatability: Record thread/MPI counts, CPU/GPU model, RAM, resolved dependency versions and seeds when algorithm exposes them. No published stochastic seed list supplied.
timing_scope.reason: No representative workload timing or memory measurement; no build/workload permitted during intake.

budget_basis: Prospective caps, not measured runtime claims. FroDock mirror README reports about 10 minutes for its unrelated 4-core example; no extrapolated benchmark result asserted. Abort and report if fixed workload cannot complete; no scale search.
execution_readiness: Published runner defects and unresolved stock-image compatibility require reproduction work; no executions performed.
published_acceptance: DockQ >= 0.23 per pose; no published whole-workload minimum success fraction or numerical reproduction tolerance established.
